summary: Frontend-only verification of the Prayer hub category-box restructure. All 11 hub testIDs render with correct meta counts (10 CHAPLETS, 6 PRAYERS, 5 LITANIES, 3 VERSIONS, 4 PRAYERS, 8 PRAYERS, 3 PRAYERS). Holy Rosary featured card shows TODAY badge and opens the prayer runner directly with 'Holy Rosary' / Joyful Mysteries. Each of the 7 category boxes (chaplets, marian, litany, stations, mass, devotional, seasonal) navigates to /prayer/category/<cat> (testID prayer-category-<cat>), lists the expected child prayer cards (prayer-card-divine_mercy, angelus, litany_loreto, stations_traditional, before_mass, st_michael_prayer, seasonal_prayers), and tapping any opens the runner with no 'Prayer not found' fallback. Category back button (prayer-category-back) returns to prayer-hub-screen. Regression: prayer-card-novenas/consecration/companions still route to /novenas, /consecration, /companions. No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Console emits non-blocking RN-Web deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Not introduced by this change but worth a future cleanup.
